blocks.source_reference_arabic: رواه مسلم، باب تحريش الشيطان...، رقم: ٧١٠٣
blocks.tamil_translation: “Shaytan has despaired of the Muslims in the Arabian Peninsula worshipping Shaytan (of their sinking into Kufr and Shirk). But he has not despaired of setting them against one another in enmity and causing discord among them.” Hazrat Jabir (RA) narrates that he heard the Prophet ﷺ say this.

blocks.arabic_text: عَنْ اَبِيْ هُرَيْرَةَ ﵁ قَالَ: قَالَ رَسُوْلُ اللهِ ﷺ: تُعْرَضُ اْلاَعْمَالُ فِيْ كُلِّ يَوْمِ خَمِيْسٍ وَاِثْنَيْنِ، فَيَغْفِرُ اللهُ فِيْ ذلِكَ الْيَوْمِ لِكُلِّ اِمْرِئئٍ لَا يُشْرِكُ بِاللهِ شَيْئًا اِلَّا امْرَأً كَانَتْ بَيْنَهُ وَبَيْنَ اَخِيْهِ شَحْنَاءُ، فَيُقَالُ: ارْكُوْا هذَيْنِ حَتَّي يَصْطَلِحَا، ارْكُوْ هذَيْنِ حَتَّي يَصْطَلِحَا.
blocks.source_reference_arabic: رواه مسلم، باب النهي عن الشحناء، رقم:٦٥٤٦
blocks.tamil_translation: “Every Monday and Thursday the deeds of the servants are presented to Allah Ta'ala, and on that day Allah Ta'ala forgives those who do not associate partners with Him. But whoever holds enmity towards his (Muslim) brother, that man will be deprived of this forgiveness. It will be said (from Allah Ta'ala to the angels), “Leave these two until they make peace between themselves; leave these two until they make peace between themselves.”” Hazrat Abu Hurairah (RA) narrates that Rasulullah ﷺ said this.

blocks.arabic_text: عَنْ مُعَاذِ بْنِ جَبَلٍ ﵁ عَنِ النَّبِيِّ ﷺ قَالَ: يَطَّلِعُ اللهُ اِلَي جَمِيْعِ خَلْقِهِ لَيْلَةَ النِّصْفِ مِنْ شَعْبَانَ فَيَغْفِرُ لِجَمِيْعِ خَلْقِهِ اِلَّا لِمُشْرِكٍ اَوْ مُشَاحِنٍ.
